policy: Capital anchors are consumed from the Phase 3 territory manifest and are never duplicated here.
Every capital is a fixed-world structure whose footprint remains inside its registered capital envelope.
Visible asset alpha and the lower structure base must remain supported by the canonical land mask.
Territory-review structures are deliberately compact: each manifest footprint is the final world size and is not multiplied by a second runtime scale.
Every authored structure exposes a normalized ground-contact anchor so its base, rather than the center of its square source canvas, lands on the territory anchor.
Approved capital sites use registered territory-landform tiles for terrain transitions; structure sprites never own surrounding ground.
Every authored raster shares one projection bearing and the root world-light direction; finished assets are never rotated at runtime.
World view remains terrain-only; capitals use the shared territory reveal weight.
Project buildings, skill buildings, roads, vegetation, labels, interaction, and effects remain deferred.
note: Legacy capital structures retired 2026-09-05 (owner: old art gone). The city layer rebuilds each capital on its territory's L2 land.
